verdict.rationale: n8n lets users build AI workflows and agents over their own data, using OpenAI, Anthropic, Google or open-source models, and it markets use cases like generating customer insights from reviews. A community user also describes using it to analyze scraped posts. These insights only come from workflows the user designs and wires up themselves, not from a built-in feature that surfaces suggestions about the user's data. Missing for 10: a native in-product insights or suggestions feature, documentation of how insights are surfaced in the UI, and hands-on corroboration beyond a single user anecdote.
